name: WAN optimizer configuration change outside the change window
author: Sentra SOC
description: A configuration change on a Silver Peak / HPE Aruba EdgeConnect WAN optimizer (appliance audit log: web UI, CLI, REST API or Orchestrator push) outside the change window (07:00-18:00 Asia/Riyadh, Sunday-Thursday) - same window as SENTRA-FW-002. Tune hour_between / weekday_in to the customer's CAB window.

name: WAN optimizer reboot or software upgrade outside the change window
author: Sentra SOC
description: A Silver Peak / EdgeConnect appliance was rebooted (requested, or the appliance's own reboot alarm) or its software was upgraded outside the change window (07:00-18:00 Asia/Riyadh, Sunday-Thursday). An unplanned reboot of a WAN optimizer drops every optimised tunnel of its site.

name: WAN optimizer tunnel down alarm
author: Sentra SOC
description: Operational: an EdgeConnect appliance raised its tunnel-down alarm (the appliance raises it once the tunnel stays down past its own detection time - verify on the release). The real-time engine cannot express 'no tunnel-up within N minutes'; the down duration against the tunnel_down_minutes threshold is measured by the WAN optimization monitor in the infrastructure service and forwarded on the infra bridge. Cleared alarms are ignored.

name: WAN optimizer tunnel flapping
author: Sentra SOC
description: Operational: the same Silver Peak / EdgeConnect tunnel went down 3 or more times within 30 minutes (unstable WAN link, MPLS / internet circuit flapping or path MTU problems between sites).
